name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
summary: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments directly to bank accounts.
eligibility: Landholding farmers families (subject to certain exclusions).

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
summary: Crop insurance scheme protecting against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest.
eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
summary: Short-term formal credit for agricultural needs at subsidized interest rates.

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
summary: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis.
eligibility: Farmers looking to sell their produce competitively.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
summary: Provides information to farmers on nutrient status of their soil along with recommendation on appropriate dosage of nutrients.
eligibility: All farmers are covered to get soil tested.
